mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as investors anticipate tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or flat despite FEDFUNDS crossing the 12-month average in the same window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coincides with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as labor market strength supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite continuous upward trend in PAYEMS over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) below the 50th percentile triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak demand reduces corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when the trigger is met, or the pattern reverses before 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production) accompanied by a simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (goods orders) signals supply-side imbalance favoring equities over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is negative despite the interaction pattern holding for the period.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months in a tightening regime, the S&P 500 shows a positive 20-day forward return as expectations of sustained easing persist.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0 AND FEDFUNDS_prev_month >= 2.0 AND FEDFUNDS_next_month >= FEDFUNDS_prev_month
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is negative despite the three-month below-2% FEDFUNDS pattern.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in UNRATE (unemployment) above 4% in a single month is associated with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as higher unemployment depresses equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE crosses above 4% without prior increase.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (production) over the next 20 days indicate accelerating demand, leading to a positive S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is negative despite both proxies rising in the same window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to supply constraint (measured by INDPRO stagnation while CPIAUCSL (inflation) remains below 3%) predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as valuations adjust downward.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO <= INDPRO_prev_month AND CPIAUCSL < 3.0 AND CPIAUCSL_prev_month < 3.0
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is positive despite the supply constraint trigger holding.
